subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth bearer credentials for batch transcription against native OpenAI `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoints?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and proven, but it reverses the current API-key-only provider-auth policy for one OpenAI Platform endpoint; repository evidence does not establish whether that expanded credential contract is an approved long-term product guarantee.

options.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
options.body: Approve OAuth for native OpenAI transcription endpoints, then refresh the branch while preserving API-key precedence and custom-endpoint exclusion.

options.title: Keep batch STT API-key-only
options.body: Reject this contract change and instead add clear validation, migration guidance, and documentation for existing OAuth-profile audio configurations.

recommendation.title: Accept native OAuth batch STT
recommendation.body: Approve OAuth for native OpenAI transcription endpoints, then refresh the branch while preserving API-key precedence and custom-endpoint exclusion.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the current API-key-only OpenAI audio-auth behavior and has recent history in the affected runner paths.
